functions.name: after
functions.doc: Runs `fn` once, `seconds` of game time later.

functions.name: audio.play
functions.doc: Plays a WAV file of the plugin's folder. `opts`: `volume` (1), `pitch` (1), `loop`, `range` (metres heard at full volume, 5), and either `x, y, z` (a sound at a map point) or `on_bus = true` (it moves with the player's bus); none: heard alike everywhere. The game's volume setting applies. A plugin plays 32 at most.

functions.name: audio.playing
functions.doc: Whether a sound of the plugin's still plays.

functions.name: audio.set
functions.doc: Changes a sound of the plugin's: `volume`, `pitch`, `range`, `x, y, z` / `on_bus`.

functions.name: audio.stop
functions.doc: Stops a sound of the plugin's.

functions.name: audio.stop_all
functions.doc: Stops every sound of the plugin's.

functions.name: audio.volume
functions.doc: The game's volume setting, 0 to 1.

functions.name: bus.acceleration
functions.doc: Its acceleration in its own frame, m/s² without gravity: to the right, forwards, up.

functions.name: bus.action
functions.doc: A key action of the vehicles (`[vehicles]` of keyboard.cfg: `horn`, `parking_brake_toggle`, `kw_scheinwerfer_toggle`, `blinker_left_set`, `ticket_give`, ...): pressed and let go, or held (`down` true) and let go (`false`). `true` when the bus knows it.

functions.name: bus.controls
functions.doc: What the bus drives with now: the pedals (0 to 1) and the steering (-1 left to 1 right), from the keys, the mouse or a controller.

functions.name: bus.damage
functions.doc: `{crashes, last_impact_kj, repair_minutes}`: the bus's crashes, the energy of the last one and how long a repair would take (`nil`: nothing to repair).

functions.name: bus.destination
functions.doc: The destination the bus shows and its index in `destinations` (nothing when none).

functions.name: bus.destinations
functions.doc: The destinations of the bus's depot file: `{index, code, name, all_exit}` (`index` from 1, for `set_destination`).

functions.name: bus.dirt
functions.doc: How dirty the bus is, 0 (clean) to 1.

functions.name: bus.door
functions.doc: Whether door leaf `n` (from 1) is open.

functions.name: bus.door_count
functions.doc: The doorways the door keys work, front to back.

functions.name: bus.doors
functions.doc: Each door leaf's position, front to back: 0 shut, 1 open (the scripts' `door_0`, `door_1`, ...).

functions.name: bus.doors_open
functions.doc: Whether any door is open (by the passengers' door flags where the bus has them).

functions.name: bus.electrics
functions.doc: Whether the bus's electrics are on (the main switch).

functions.name: bus.engine
functions.doc: The engine: whether it runs, its rpm (where the bus shows one) and whether the electrics are on.

functions.name: bus.engine_running
functions.doc: Whether the engine runs.

functions.name: bus.file
functions.doc: The bus's `.bus` file, relative to the game folder.

functions.name: bus.fuel
functions.doc: The fuel in the tank, litres (the scripts' `engine_tank_content`).

functions.name: bus.gear
functions.doc: The gear engaged (-1 reverse, 0 neutral), where the bus shows one.

functions.name: bus.get_strings
functions.doc: The same for string variables.

functions.name: bus.get_vars
functions.doc: Many script variables at once: a table name -> value of the names given, or of every variable of the bus without a list.

functions.name: bus.handbrake
functions.doc: Whether the parking brake is on.

functions.name: bus.headlights
functions.doc: The headlights: 0 off, 1 side lights, 2 dipped, 3 high beam.

functions.name: bus.horn
functions.doc: Whether the horn sounds.

functions.name: bus.indicator
functions.doc: The indicators: `"off"`, `"left"`, `"right"` or `"hazard"`.

functions.name: bus.interior_light
functions.doc: The passenger room's light, 0 (off) to 1.

functions.name: bus.km_today
functions.doc: Kilometres driven this session (as the personnel file counts them).

functions.name: bus.kneeling
functions.doc: Whether the bus kneels.

functions.name: bus.mass
functions.doc: The bus's mass in kg.

functions.name: bus.number
functions.doc: The bus's fleet number.

functions.name: bus.odometer
functions.doc: The bus's odometer in km.

functions.name: bus.orientation
functions.doc: Heading (degrees clockwise from north), pitch (nose up positive) and bank (right side down positive).

functions.name: bus.passengers
functions.doc: The people aboard the bus: all, sitting, standing.

functions.name: bus.play_sound
functions.doc: Plays the bus's own sound of this event (a trigger name of its sound files, `ev_...`).

functions.name: bus.retarder
functions.doc: The retarder's step, where the bus has one.

functions.name: bus.rpm
functions.doc: The engine's revolutions per minute.

functions.name: bus.sales
functions.doc: Tickets sold this session and the money taken (the game knows no currency).

functions.name: bus.set_destination
functions.doc: Shows destination `index` (from 1, as `destinations` lists them).

functions.name: bus.set_indicator
functions.doc: Sets the indicators: `"off"`, `"left"`, `"right"` or `"hazard"`.

functions.name: bus.set_interior_light
functions.doc: Switches the passenger room's light on or off.

functions.name: bus.set_line
functions.doc: Types a line (route) into the bus's IBIS, as the player would.

functions.name: bus.set_vars
functions.doc: Sets many script variables at once (a table name -> number); how many the bus has.

functions.name: bus.shift
functions.doc: Puts a manual gearbox's lever in a gear (-1 reverse, 0 neutral).

functions.name: bus.sound_horn
functions.doc: Holds the horn (`true`) or lets it go.

functions.name: bus.start_up
functions.doc: Starts the bus up the way Shift+U does (the battery, the electrics, the engine) - or shuts a running bus down; what the game says it does.

functions.name: bus.state
functions.doc: Everything a dashboard shows, in one table: `speed` (km/h, signed), `gear`, `engine` (running), `rpm`, `electrics`, `doors_open`, `indicator`, `headlights`, `dirt`, `passengers`, `odometer`, `km_today`, `throttle`, `brake`, `clutch`, `steering`, `fuel`, `handbrake`, `horn`, `stop_request` (a key is `nil` where the bus does not have it).

functions.name: bus.steering_angle
functions.doc: The front wheels' angle and the most they turn, degrees (right positive).

functions.name: bus.stop_brake
functions.doc: Whether the stop brake (the door brake) holds the bus.

functions.name: bus.stop_requested
functions.doc: Whether a passenger has asked to stop.

functions.name: bus.ticket_request
functions.doc: The ticket the passenger at the cash desk asks for (nothing when nobody asks).

functions.name: bus.tickets
functions.doc: The tickets the map sells: `{name, price, day_ticket}`.

functions.name: bus.toggle_door
functions.doc: Presses the key of doorway `n` (from 1; 0 or none: all doors), as the player would.

functions.name: bus.toggle_handbrake
functions.doc: Puts the parking brake on or off, as its key does.

functions.name: bus.trailers
functions.doc: Parts coupled behind the bus (an articulated bus's rear counts).

functions.name: bus.triggers
functions.doc: The names of the bus's script triggers (for `trigger`, `press`).

functions.name: bus.velocity
functions.doc: The bus's speed in km/h, negative backwards.

functions.name: bus.velocity_vector
functions.doc: Its velocity in the world, m/s (x east, y north, z up).

functions.name: bus.wheels
functions.doc: Each wheel: `{axle, side, rpm, radius, suspension, driven}` (`side` 0 left, 1 right; `suspension` the spring's travel).

functions.name: camera.fov
functions.doc: Its vertical field of view, degrees.

functions.name: camera.get
functions.doc: The camera: `{view, x, y, z, yaw, pitch, roll, fov, in_cab, zoom, look_yaw, look_pitch, width, height}` - map metres, degrees (yaw clockwise from north, pitch up positive), the vertical field of view, the picture's pixels.

functions.name: camera.in_cab
functions.doc: Whether the camera is in the player's own bus (driver or passenger view).

functions.name: camera.look
functions.doc: Turns the head (driver, passenger view) or swings the outside camera round the bus: degrees from straight ahead.

functions.name: camera.orientation
functions.doc: Where it looks, degrees.

functions.name: camera.position
functions.doc: Where the camera is (map metres).

functions.name: camera.project
functions.doc: Where a map point is seen on the screen, in the panels' pixels (as `ui.screen` measures them); nothing when it is behind the camera. For labels over buses, stops, people.

functions.name: camera.set_free
functions.doc: Puts the free camera at a map point looking along `yaw` and `pitch` (degrees); the view becomes `"free"` (the player moves it on from there).

functions.name: camera.set_view
functions.doc: Switches the view: `"driver"`, `"pax"`, `"outside"`, `"map"` (the free camera above the bus), `"ego"` (walking), or a `view_*` action of keyboard.cfg.

functions.name: camera.set_zoom
functions.doc: The zoom of the view now (its field of view times this, 0.2 to 3).

functions.name: camera.view
functions.doc: The view: `"driver"`, `"pax"`, `"outside"`, `"free"` or `"foot"`.

functions.name: cancel
functions.doc: Stops a timer, a watch or a hotkey; `true` when there was one.

functions.name: clock
functions.doc: The game's time of day as `"HH:MM:SS"`.

functions.name: command
functions.doc: Does what a line of the game menu does: `refuel`, `wash`, `repair`, `shot`, `save`, `load`, `weather`, `later`, `earlier`, `info`, `timetable`, `reset`, `couple`, `uncouple`; `true` when the game knows it (it runs after the frame).

functions.name: debug
functions.doc: A line of the log's debug level (shown with `RUST_LOG=debug`).

functions.name: distance
functions.doc: Metres from the bus to a map point, or `nil` on foot.

functions.name: duty.active
functions.doc: Whether the player drives a duty (a line and tour of the timetable).

functions.name: duty.at_stop
functions.doc: Whether the bus stands at the next stop (within 25 m of it).

functions.name: duty.delay
functions.doc: Seconds the bus is late (early negative), worked out between the stops as the game's timetable does.

functions.name: duty.finish
functions.doc: Gives the duty up (the bus drives on without a timetable); `true` when there was one.

functions.name: duty.get
functions.doc: The duty now: `line`, `tour`, `trip` (its number in the duty, from 1), `trips`, `trip_name`, `terminus`, `departure`, `arrival`, `stops`, `next_stop` and `previous_stop` (each a stop: `{number, name, id, arrival, departure, stops, x, y, z}`), `at_stop`, `trip_done`, `delay` (seconds, late positive).

functions.name: duty.next_stop
functions.doc: The next stop of the trip (as `duty.stops` gives them).

functions.name: duty.skip_stop
functions.doc: Skips the next stop (the duty goes on to the one after); the name of the stop skipped.

functions.name: duty.skip_to
functions.doc: Makes stop `stop` (from 1) of the trip the next one, forwards or back.

functions.name: duty.start
functions.doc: Takes a duty, as the game menu's "Line and tour" does: a line and tour of `timetable.lines`, its trip (from 1 in the order they leave; default the first) and the stop to start at (from 1 among those the trip calls at; default the first). The bus stays where it is.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: duty.stops
functions.doc: The stops of the trip now: `{number, name, id, arrival, departure, stops, passed, x, y, z}` (`stops` false: the bus passes it; `x, y, z` where the stop's place is known; `id` the map's object id).

functions.name: duty.trip_stops
functions.doc: The stops of a trip of the duty (from 1), as `duty.stops` gives them.

functions.name: duty.trips
functions.doc: The trips of the duty: `{number, name, line, terminus, departure, arrival, stops}`.

functions.name: emit
functions.doc: Sends an event to this plugin's own handlers at once (handy between the modules of a bigger plugin); an error of a handler is this call's.

functions.name: error
functions.doc: The same as an error line (the plugin goes on).

functions.name: every
functions.doc: Runs `fn` every `seconds` of game time.

functions.name: files.append
functions.doc: Adds to the end of a file of the data folder (a log, a CSV of trips).
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: files.delete
functions.doc: Removes a file or an empty folder of the data folder.

functions.name: files.dir
functions.doc: Where the data folder is on this computer (to tell the player; the plugin reaches it with relative paths only).

functions.name: files.exists
functions.doc: Whether the data folder has this file or folder.

functions.name: files.list
functions.doc: The entries of the data folder (or a folder in it): `{name, dir, size}`.
functions.returns: list of tables, or nil and the reason

functions.name: files.mkdir
functions.doc: Makes a folder (and those above it) in the data folder.

functions.name: files.read
functions.doc: A file of the plugin's data folder (`path` relative to it; `..` and absolute paths are refused).
functions.returns: text, or nil and the reason

functions.name: files.write
functions.doc: Writes a file of the data folder (its folders are made); at most 16 MB at once and 256 MB in all.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: fmt.clock
functions.doc: Seconds since midnight as `"HH:MM"` (`"HH:MM:SS"` with `true`); past midnight wraps.

functions.name: fmt.delay
functions.doc: A delay as a timetable display shows it: `"+2:30"` late, `"-0:45"` early, `"0:00"`.

functions.name: fmt.distance
functions.doc: A distance as `"350 m"` or `"2.4 km"`.

functions.name: fmt.duration
functions.doc: A length of time as people read it: `"45 s"`, `"3 min 05 s"`, `"1 h 20 min"` (negative with a minus).

functions.name: fmt.money
functions.doc: An amount with two decimals and a currency symbol after it (`"12.50 €"`; the game knows no currency of its own).

functions.name: fmt.number
functions.doc: A number with `decimals` (0) and a thousands `separator` (`","`, `" "`; none by default).

functions.name: fmt.pad
functions.doc: A text made `width` characters long with spaces (on the left with `right` = true, to line numbers up), or cut to it.

functions.name: fmt.speed
functions.doc: A speed as `"42 km/h"`, or in `"mph"` or `"m/s"`.

functions.name: fmt.split
functions.doc: A text cut at every `separator` (`","` by default; plainly, no patterns).

functions.name: fmt.trim
functions.doc: A text without the spaces at its ends.

functions.name: game.action
functions.doc: A game action of keyboard.cfg's `[game]` (`sim_pause`, `view_set_map`, `view_toggle_informationdisplay`, `view_set_schedule`, ...), as its key does; `true` when the game knows it.

functions.name: game.api
functions.doc: The version of the plugin interface (`api_abi` of an `.oop`; raised only when something is taken away or changes).

functions.name: game.fps
functions.doc: Frames a second now.

functions.name: game.has
functions.doc: Whether this game has an API function (`"weather.set"`): for a plugin that should also run in an older openOMSI.

functions.name: game.menu_open
functions.doc: Whether the game menu is open.

functions.name: game.notify
functions.doc: A notification of the game's own (the cards the server's messages use): `kind` `"info"`, `"warning"` or `"alert"`.

functions.name: game.platform
functions.doc: The system the game runs on: `"windows"`, `"macos"`, `"linux"`, `"android"`.

functions.name: game.screenshot
functions.doc: Takes a screenshot with the next frame, as the camera key does; the file it goes to (the `screenshot` event says when it is there).

functions.name: game.settings
functions.doc: The settings a plugin may read: `graphics` (`"vanilla"`, `"vanilla_plus"`, `"enhanced"`), `language` (the cockpit's, `"ENG"`), `ui_language`, `ui_scale`, `volume`, `fov`, `render_scale`, `max_fps`, `fullscreen`, `vsync`, `msaa`, `shadows`, `time_speed`, `units` (`"metric"`: speeds are km/h everywhere), ...

functions.name: game.stats
functions.doc: This session's counts, as the personnel file has them: `km`, `stops_served`, `stops_skipped`, `crashes`, `heavy_crashes`, `pedestrians`, `tickets`, `cash`, `passengers`, ...

functions.name: game.version
functions.doc: The game's version (`"0.2.22"`).

functions.name: has_vehicle
functions.doc: `true` while the player drives a vehicle.

functions.name: info
functions.doc: What the game is doing: `map`, `clock` (seconds since midnight), `day`, `year`, `view`, `paused`, `on_foot`, `multiplayer`, `traffic`, `speed`, `delay`, `map_path`, `version`; with a bus also `tile_x`, `tile_y`, `tile_pos_x`, `tile_pos_y`, `heading`, `vehicle_manufacturer`, `vehicle_model`, `destination`, `passengers`; `crashes`, `heavy_crashes`, `pedestrians_hit`; `situation`; on a duty also `line`, `tour`, `trip`, `trips`, `trip_name`, `terminus`, `stops`, `trip_done`, `next_stop`, `next_stop_number`, `next_stop_arrival`, `next_stop_departure`, `next_stop_id`, `at_stop`, `previous_stop`, `previous_stop_id`, `next_stop_distance`, `previous_stop_distance` (see the plugin docs for each).

functions.name: info_value
functions.doc: One value of `info()` without building the whole table: cheaper for a plugin that reads one or two every frame.

functions.name: input.bindings
functions.doc: The key bindings: `{action, key}` of the game's keys, or the vehicles' with `true` (`key` as the game writes it: `"Ctrl+D"`).

functions.name: input.controllers
functions.doc: The steering wheels, pedals, joysticks and gamepads: `{name, gamepad, axes, buttons}` (`axes` each axis's value; `buttons` how many it has - the `controller_button` event tells presses).

functions.name: input.hotkey
functions.doc: Runs `fn(key)` when a key combination is pressed: `"F10"`, `"Ctrl+KeyH"`, `"Shift+Alt+Digit1"` (modifiers exact: `"KeyH"` is not `Ctrl+KeyH`). The keys still reach the bus. `cancel(id)` removes it.

functions.name: input.key_down
functions.doc: Whether a key is held now (winit's names, as the `key` event: `"KeyW"`, `"ShiftLeft"`, `"F5"`).

functions.name: input.keys_down
functions.doc: Every key held now.

functions.name: input.mouse
functions.doc: The mouse: where it is in the panels' pixels and its buttons held.

functions.name: json.decode
functions.doc: Reads JSON text: objects and arrays become tables, `null` nil.
functions.returns: value, or nil and the reason

functions.name: json.encode
functions.doc: A value as JSON text (a list as an array, a table with keys as an object; `pretty`: indented).

functions.name: lan.active
functions.doc: Whether this game is in a LAN session.

functions.name: lan.chat
functions.doc: Says a line in the session's chat, as the player would (every player sees it; at most one a second).
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: lan.me
functions.doc: This player in the session: its id (the host is 1), its name, whether it hosts.

functions.name: lan.players
functions.doc: The other players of the session: `{id, name, host, bus, line, tour, x, y, z, heading, speed, on_foot, passengers}`.

functions.name: lan.send
functions.doc: Sends a short text (at most 120 characters, no `|`) to the same plugin on another player's game (`to` its id; 0: every other player); it hears `lan_message(from, text)`. A player sends at most about ten a second; a game without the plugin ignores them.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: log
functions.doc: A line in `game.log`, tagged `[lua <name>]` (`print` does the same).

functions.name: map.entrypoints
functions.doc: The map's start points: `{index, name, x, y, z, heading}` (`index` from 1; the place where the game has read its tile).

functions.name: map.ground
functions.doc: The height of the ground (the road where there is one, else the terrain) at a map point, where its tile is loaded.

functions.name: map.info
functions.doc: `{name, friendly_name, path, left_hand_traffic, tile_size}`: the map's names, its global.cfg and the side it drives on.

functions.name: map.lane
functions.doc: The traffic lane nearest to a map point: `{index, distance, speed_limit, name, traffic_light}`.

functions.name: map.name
functions.doc: The map's name (its folder's).

functions.name: map.object
functions.doc: Where a map object is, by its id (a stop's id of the timetable, say); nothing when the game has not read its tile.

functions.name: map.objects_near
functions.doc: The map objects within `radius` m (default 50, at most 2000 of them, nearest first): `{id, x, y, z, heading, distance}`.

functions.name: map.place_on_road
functions.doc: Puts the player's bus on the street nearest to a map point (within 300 m), along it.

functions.name: map.speed_limit
functions.doc: The speed limit (km/h) of the lane the player's bus drives on (`nil` off the lanes).

functions.name: map.stops
functions.doc: The bus stops of the tiles loaded (around the camera): `{id, name, x, y, z, heading}`.

functions.name: map.teleport
functions.doc: Moves the player's bus to a map point (z none: onto the highest ground there) facing `heading` (default north), as the game menu's move does; the `service` event says `teleport`.

functions.name: map.teleport_to
functions.doc: Moves the player's bus to start point `index` (from 1, as `map.entrypoints` lists them).

functions.name: map.terrain
functions.doc: The terrain's height alone at a map point.

functions.name: map.tile
functions.doc: The tile the player's bus is on (nothing on foot).

functions.name: map.tile_at
functions.doc: The tile of a map point and the metres in it (x east, y north).

functions.name: map.tiles
functions.doc: The map's tiles: `{x, y, file, loaded}` (numbered as global.cfg's `[map]` list).

functions.name: map.to_world
functions.doc: A place given by its tile and the metres in it, in map coordinates.

functions.name: message
functions.doc: A line of text on the screen (5 seconds when not given).

functions.name: off
functions.doc: Removes a handler added with `on`.

functions.name: on
functions.doc: Adds a handler of an event (see the events); several may hear one event, in the order they were added.

functions.name: other_var
functions.doc: A script variable of one of `others`, or `nil`.

functions.name: others
functions.doc: The other vehicles within `radius` m of the bus (default 300): each `{id, kind, name, x, y, z, heading}`, `kind` being `"ai"` (the traffic) or `"player"` (another player's bus in a LAN game); empty on foot.

functions.name: people.counts
functions.doc: The people of the map near the camera: walking, waiting at stops, riding a bus.

functions.name: people.density
functions.doc: The people setting: 0 to 3, 1 the map's own amount.

functions.name: people.list
functions.doc: The people (within `radius` m of the player's bus, when given): `{id, x, y, z, state, aboard, ai_bus, stop, destination, ticket, complaint}`. `state`: `"strolling"`, `"idle"`, `"standing"`, `"waiting"`, `"to_bus"`, `"boarding"`, `"riding"`, `"seated"`, `"leaving"`, `"to_stop"`; `aboard` in the player's bus; `complaint` 0 to 3 (3: they leave).

functions.name: people.set_density
functions.doc: Changes the people setting (0 to 3).

functions.name: people.stops
functions.doc: The stops near the camera where people wait: `{id, name, x, y, z, waiting}`.

functions.name: people.waiting
functions.doc: How many people wait at a stop (its map object id).

functions.name: plugin.broadcast
functions.doc: Sends a message to every other plugin loaded.

functions.name: plugin.disable
functions.doc: Switches the plugin off until its file changes or the game starts again (its `stop` comes).

functions.name: plugin.errors
functions.doc: How many errors the plugin had (at 10 it is switched off).

functions.name: plugin.files
functions.doc: The files of the plugin's own folder (or a folder in it): `{name, dir, size}`.

functions.name: plugin.list
functions.doc: The names of the plugins loaded, this one too.

functions.name: plugin.name
functions.doc: The plugin's name: its file's, or its folder's for a `main.lua`.

functions.name: plugin.permissions
functions.doc: The permissions the plugin has (a plain `.lua` file has them all).

functions.name: plugin.read
functions.doc: A file of the plugin's own folder (a table of stops, a translation): read only, relative to the folder.
functions.returns: text, or nil and the reason

functions.name: plugin.send
functions.doc: Sends a message to another plugin (by its name): it hears `message(from, topic, data)` in its next frame. The data is numbers, texts, booleans or tables of them.

functions.name: plugin.set_setting
functions.doc: Changes a setting (held to its range; saved); `true` when it took the value.

functions.name: plugin.setting
functions.doc: A setting's value (`nil`: no such setting).

functions.name: plugin.settings
functions.doc: Declares the plugin's settings: a list of `{key, type, label, default}` with `type` `"bool"`, `"number"` (`min`, `max`, `step`), `"text"` or `"choice"` (`choices`, a list of texts). The values the player chose before come back (as a table key -> value); the game makes a settings panel of them (`plugin.show_settings`), saves them in the data folder and sends `setting(key, value)` when one changes.

functions.name: plugin.show_settings
functions.doc: Shows the plugin's settings panel (or hides it with `false`); it can be dragged and closed while the panels have the mouse (`ui.focus`). `false` when the plugin declared no settings.

functions.name: position
functions.doc: Where the bus is: map metres (x east, y north, z up) and its heading in degrees clockwise from north; nothing on foot.

functions.name: press
functions.doc: Holds a key of the bus down: fires the trigger `name` (let it go with `release`).

functions.name: release
functions.doc: Lets a key go: fires `<name>_off`.

functions.name: send
functions.doc: Sends `data` as one UDP datagram to `127.0.0.1:port`: to another program on this computer, never over the network. Not sent when the port is below 1024 or one of the game's multiplayer ports (27015-27024), the message is longer than 8 KB, or the plugin sent 100 in the last second.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: set_other_var
functions.doc: Sets a script variable of one of `others`; `true` when that vehicle has it. An AI vehicle keeps it until its scripts write it again; another player's bus takes its values from the network again.

functions.name: set_str
functions.doc: Sets a string variable; `true` when the bus has it.

functions.name: set_var
functions.doc: Sets a script variable; `true` when the bus has that variable.

functions.name: speed
functions.doc: The bus's speed in km/h, forwards or backwards (0 on foot).

functions.name: storage.all
functions.doc: Everything stored, as one table.

functions.name: storage.clear
functions.doc: Removes every key.

functions.name: storage.delete
functions.doc: Removes a key; `true` when it was there.

functions.name: storage.get
functions.doc: A value the plugin stored, or `nil`. The storage is the plugin's own and survives the session (kept as `storage.json` in its data folder).

functions.name: storage.keys
functions.doc: The keys stored, in the order they were first set.

functions.name: storage.save
functions.doc: Writes the storage now (it is written by itself when the game ends).

functions.name: storage.set
functions.doc: Stores a value under a key: a number, text, boolean or a table of them (`nil` removes it). It is written when the game ends, the plugin is loaded again, or `storage.save()` is called.

functions.name: str
functions.doc: A string variable of the bus's scripts (`IBIS_terminus_name`).

functions.name: sys
functions.doc: A system variable of the scripts: `Time`, `Day`, `Weather_Temperature`, `SunAlt`, ... (read only).

functions.name: time
functions.doc: Seconds of game time since the plugin started (stands still while paused).

functions.name: timetable.buses
functions.doc: The timetable buses of the AI on the road: `{id, line, tour, trip, terminus, departure, next_stop_id, at_stop, trip_done, delay, x, y, number}`.

functions.name: timetable.lines
functions.doc: The map's lines: `{name, user_allowed, tours}`, each tour `{number, today, trips}` (`today`: it runs on the game's date).

functions.name: timetable.stop_names
functions.doc: The stops the timetable knows: `{id, name}` (`id` the map's object id).

functions.name: timetable.stops
functions.doc: The stops of a tour's trips (or of its trip `trip`, from 1 in the order they leave) that the bus calls at: `{trip, station, name, departure}`.

functions.name: traffic.ahead
functions.doc: The AI vehicle ahead of the player's bus within `reach` m (default 100) and 20° of its heading, with its `distance`: for a distance warning or a cruise control.

functions.name: traffic.clear
functions.doc: Takes every car not running to a timetable off the road; how many went.

functions.name: traffic.counts
functions.doc: The AI vehicles: driving, timetable buses among them, asleep out of range, parked.

functions.name: traffic.density
functions.doc: How many cars the traffic keeps around the camera, and the share of them that do not run to a timetable (0 to 1).

functions.name: traffic.get
functions.doc: One AI vehicle by its id, as `traffic.list` gives them.

functions.name: traffic.light_ahead
functions.doc: The traffic light the player's bus comes to within `reach` m (default 80): `{aspect, change_in, distance}` - `aspect` `"red"`, `"red_yellow"`, `"green"`, `"green_yellow"`, `"yellow"` or `"dark"`, `change_in` the seconds to its next change.

functions.name: traffic.list
functions.doc: The AI vehicles (within `radius` m of the player's bus, when given): `{id, kind, name, x, y, z, heading, speed, max_speed, waiting_for, standing, braking, blinker, line, distance}`. `kind`: `"car"`, `"taxi"`, `"bus"`, `"truck"`, `"timetable_bus"`, `"tram"`, `"bicycle"`; `waiting_for` why it waits or slows (`"lead"`, `"light"`, `"yield"`, `"people"`, ...); `standing` the seconds it has stood.

functions.name: traffic.nearest
functions.doc: The AI vehicle nearest to the player's bus (of that `kind`, when given), with its `distance`.

functions.name: traffic.remove
functions.doc: Takes an AI vehicle off the road (a timetable bus too: its timetable forgets it); its passengers get out.

functions.name: traffic.set_density
functions.doc: Changes the traffic's amount (as the game menu's slider: 0 to 500 cars) and, when given, the share not running to a timetable; it fills up or thins out over the next seconds.

functions.name: trigger
functions.doc: A key press of the bus: fires the trigger, then `<name>_off`.

functions.name: ui.clear
functions.doc: Removes every panel of the plugin.

functions.name: ui.focus
functions.doc: `true`: the panels get the mouse (the cursor shows, a click goes to the panel under it and none to the bus); `false`, Esc or a menu of the game gives it back. Returns the new state.

functions.name: ui.focused
functions.doc: Whether the panels have the mouse.

functions.name: ui.moved
functions.doc: How far the player dragged a panel from where its table puts it (pixels).

functions.name: ui.panels
functions.doc: The ids of the plugin's panels.

functions.name: ui.remove
functions.doc: Removes a panel; `true` when there was one.

functions.name: ui.screen
functions.doc: The screen in the panels' pixels, and how many of the screen's own pixels one of them is.

functions.name: ui.set
functions.doc: Creates the panel `id` or replaces it; a table that is not right gives `false` and where (`"children[2].size: a number is expected"`). The same table again changes nothing.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: ui.show
functions.doc: Shows a panel (or hides it with `false`; it is kept); `false` when there is none.

functions.name: ui.toast
functions.doc: A notification card at the top right, newest at the top; it goes after `opts.seconds` (1 to 60, default 5). `opts`: `title`, `icon`, `color`. A plugin shows 8 at most: a ninth makes its oldest go.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: ui.toggle
functions.doc: Shows a hidden panel or hides a shown one; whether it shows now.

functions.name: ui.typing
functions.doc: Whether the player types into a text field of a plugin now (the keys then go to the field, not to the bus).

functions.name: ui.update
functions.doc: Changes one element of a panel in place, by its id: `text`, `color`, `value` (a bar, a slider), `checked`, `selected`, `name` (an icon), `values` (a chart), `rows` (a table), `src` (an image) - cheaper than setting the whole panel again.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: ui.value
functions.doc: The value of a checkbox, slider, text field or tabs element now (as `ui_change` gives it).

functions.name: util.date
functions.doc: A real time (`util.now()` by default) as `{year, month, day, hour, minute, second, weekday}` in UTC (`weekday` 1 Monday).

functions.name: util.ms
functions.doc: Milliseconds of real time since the game started: for timing a plugin's own work.

functions.name: util.now
functions.doc: The real time: seconds since 1970 (UTC), with fractions.

functions.name: util.random
functions.doc: A random number: 0 to 1 without arguments, else a whole number from `min` to `max` (as `math.random`, but not repeating the same row in every plugin).

functions.name: var
functions.doc: A script variable of the bus (`Velocity`, `elec_busbar_main`, the names the `.osc` files and `.opl` lists use); `nil` without a bus or for a name it does not have.

functions.name: vars
functions.doc: The names of every variable of the bus's scripts, or of every string variable with `"str"`.

functions.name: vec.angle_diff
functions.doc: The turn from heading `a` to heading `b`, -180 to 180 degrees (right positive).

functions.name: vec.bearing
functions.doc: The heading from one map point to another.

functions.name: vec.clamp
functions.doc: `x` held between `min` and `max`.

functions.name: vec.distance
functions.doc: Metres between two map points (on the ground: x and y).

functions.name: vec.distance3
functions.doc: Metres between two points in space.

functions.name: vec.dot
functions.doc: The dot product of two 2D vectors.

functions.name: vec.heading
functions.doc: The heading of a direction on the map, degrees clockwise from north (0 to 360), as the game's headings.

functions.name: vec.length
functions.doc: The length of a vector (2D, or 3D with `z`).

functions.name: vec.lerp
functions.doc: From `a` to `b` by `t` (0 to 1, not held to it).

functions.name: vec.normalize
functions.doc: The vector made 1 long (0 stays 0).

functions.name: vec.rotate
functions.doc: A vector turned clockwise by `degrees` (as headings turn).

functions.name: vec.to_local
functions.doc: A map point seen from a place facing `heading`: metres to the right and ahead of it.

functions.name: vehicle
functions.doc: The vehicle's name (manufacturer and type), or `nil` on foot.

functions.name: vehicle_manufacturer
functions.doc: The manufacturer part of the vehicle's name, as its `[friendlyname]` has it (`"Solaris III Gen"`).

functions.name: vehicle_model
functions.doc: The model part of the vehicle's name (`"Urbino 10 / 2D"`).

functions.name: warn
functions.doc: The same as a warning.

functions.name: watch
functions.doc: Runs `fn(new, old)` whenever a value changes: `watch(name, fn)` a variable of the bus, `watch(kind, name, fn)` of kind `"var"`, `"str"`, `"sys"` or `"info"` (a key of `info()`).

functions.name: weather.get
functions.doc: The weather now: `{name, visibility (m), wind_direction (°), wind_speed (m/s), temperature (°C), humidity (%), absolute_humidity (g/m³), pressure (hPa), clouds, cloud_base (m), precipitation ("none", "rain", "snow"), precipitation_rate (0..1), snow_cover, snow_on_road, wetness (the roads, 0..1), changing, locked}` (`locked`: it follows a real weather station and cannot be set).

functions.name: weather.precipitation
functions.doc: `"none"`, `"rain"` or `"snow"`, and how hard (0 to 1).

functions.name: weather.preset
functions.doc: Changes to a weather file (as `weather.presets` names it; `""`: the map's own, changing with the day) over `seconds` (default 1).
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: weather.presets
functions.doc: The weather files installed: `{file, name}`.

functions.name: weather.set
functions.doc: Changes the weather as the game menu's sliders do; any of `visibility`, `wind_direction`, `wind_speed`, `temperature`, `pressure`, `clouds` (`"-1"` none, `"Cumulus 1"`..`"3"`, `"Overcast 1"`), `cloud_base`, `precipitation` (`"none"`, `"rain"`, `"snow"`), `precipitation_rate` (0..1), `snow_cover`, `snow_on_road`, `wetness`; the rest stays. Held to the game's ranges; refused in a LAN game as a client or while the weather follows a station.
functions.returns: true, or false and the reason

functions.name: weather.temperature
functions.doc: The air temperature, °C.

functions.name: weather.visibility
functions.doc: How far one sees, metres.

functions.name: weather.wetness
functions.doc: How wet the roads are, 0 (dry) to 1.

functions.name: weather.wind
functions.doc: The wind: where it comes from (degrees) and its speed (m/s).

functions.name: world.date
functions.doc: The game's date: `{year, month, day, weekday, day_of_year}` (`weekday` 1 Monday to 7 Sunday).

functions.name: world.pause
functions.doc: Pauses the game, as P does (not in a LAN game). The plugins stand still with it: the player resumes it.

functions.name: world.paused
functions.doc: Whether the game stands still (a plugin hears `pause` and runs no more until `resume`).

functions.name: world.play_time
functions.doc: Seconds played this session (game time, never wraps).

functions.name: world.season
functions.doc: The season's texture folder (`nil`: the base textures) and whether snow lies.

functions.name: world.set_date
functions.doc: Sets the game's date (the season's textures follow).

functions.name: world.set_time
functions.doc: Sets the time of day: seconds since midnight or `"HH:MM"` / `"HH:MM:SS"`, as the game menu's clock does (the timetable starts again after a jump of minutes). Not in a LAN game as a client, nor while the clock follows the computer's.

functions.name: world.set_time_speed
functions.doc: Sets how much faster the clock runs (1 to 30; not in a LAN game).

functions.name: world.sun_altitude
functions.doc: The sun's height over the horizon, degrees.

functions.name: world.time
functions.doc: The game's time of day, seconds since midnight.

functions.name: world.time_speed
functions.doc: How much faster than real time the game's clock runs (1 to 30).

events.name: start
events.doc: Right after the plugin was loaded (also after a reload).

events.name: vehicle
events.doc: The player got into a vehicle, changed it, or left it (`nil`).

events.name: frame
events.doc: Every frame of the game, after the bus's own scripts; not while paused. `dt` is the frame's seconds of game time.

events.name: stop
events.doc: The game ends, or the plugin is about to be loaded again.

events.name: key
events.doc: A key went down (`true`) or came up: winit's name of it (`"KeyH"`, `"F5"`, `"Numpad8"`).

events.name: next_stop
events.doc: The duty's next stop changed, also to one of the same name (`omsi.info().next_stop_number` tells them apart).

events.name: view
events.doc: The view changed (`"driver"`, `"pax"`, `"outside"`, `"free"`, `"foot"`).

events.name: duty
events.doc: A line and tour were taken (or given up: `nil`).

events.name: crash
events.doc: The player's bus crashed: every crash, also one the same as the last (the screen's "Crash: 136 kJ"); above 50 kJ it is a heavy one.

events.name: pedestrian
events.doc: The bus knocked people down.

events.name: stops_skipped
events.doc: The duty jumped ahead: the bus passed stops of its trip without stopping (or was moved) and is now at a later one; the stops are numbered in the trip from 1.

events.name: service
events.doc: The player's bus was serviced or moved. `kind`: `"refuel"` (amount: litres put in), `"wash"` (amount: the dirt left), `"repair"` (amount: the game minutes it took), `"reset"` or `"teleport"`; `by`: `"player"`, `"plugin"`, `"host"` or `"game"`.

events.name: trip_done
events.doc: A trip of the duty ended, once: its number in the duty, `"arrived"`, `"skipped"` or `"given_up"`, then its ratings in per cent (driving, comfort, ticket selling).

events.name: jolt
events.doc: The bus braked, sped up or cornered hard enough to cost driving rating (m/s², signed); at most one a second.

events.name: ticket_sold
events.doc: A ticket was sold at the cash desk: its name and price as the bus's ticket list has them.

events.name: ui_click
events.doc: A button (or another clickable part) of one of the plugin's panels was clicked; `element` is `nil` for the panel itself. Enter in a text field is a click on it.

events.name: ui_focus
events.doc: The panels got the mouse or gave it back (also by Esc, or a menu of the game opening).

events.name: ui_change
events.doc: A checkbox (`true`/`false`), slider (its number), text field (its text, at every key) or tabs element (the tab's number from 1) of the plugin's panels was changed by the player.

events.name: message
events.doc: Another plugin sent this one a message (`plugin.send`, `plugin.broadcast`): its name, the topic and the data (numbers, texts, tables).

events.name: setting
events.doc: The player changed one of the plugin's settings in its settings panel (`plugin.settings`).

events.name: door
events.doc: A door leaf of the player's bus opened (`true`) or closed: its number from 1, front to back.

events.name: doors
events.doc: The bus's doors opened (`true`: one or more open) or were all closed.

events.name: engine_start
events.doc: The player's bus's engine started running.

events.name: engine_stop
events.doc: Its engine stopped.

events.name: gear
events.doc: The gear engaged changed (-1 reverse, 0 neutral), where the bus has a gearbox it shows.

events.name: indicator
events.doc: The indicators changed: `"off"`, `"left"`, `"right"` or `"hazard"`.

events.name: headlights
events.doc: The headlights changed: 0 off, 1 side lights, 2 dipped, 3 high beam.

events.name: horn
events.doc: The horn started (`true`) or stopped.

events.name: handbrake
events.doc: The parking brake was put on (`true`) or released.

events.name: stop_request
events.doc: A passenger asked to stop (`true`), or the request went out.

events.name: passengers
events.doc: The number of passengers aboard the player's bus changed.

events.name: passenger_board
events.doc: People got into the player's bus: how many, and the stop they waited at (its map object id, `nil` when none).

events.name: passenger_alight
events.doc: People got out of the player's bus.

events.name: stop_arrive
events.doc: The bus came to the duty's next stop (within 25 m of it): its name, map object id, number in the trip (from 1) and the delay in seconds (late positive).

events.name: stop_depart
events.doc: The bus left the stop it stood at (more than 35 m from it, or the duty moved on): the same values, the delay as it left.

events.name: trip_start
events.doc: The duty moved on to another trip: its number in the duty (from 1), the timetable's name of the trip and its terminus.

events.name: duty_start
events.doc: A duty was taken.

events.name: duty_end
events.doc: The duty was given up (or another taken: `duty_end` of the old one comes first).

events.name: destination
events.doc: The destination the bus shows changed.

events.name: coupled
events.doc: Something was coupled to or uncoupled from the bus: the parts behind it now.

events.name: minute
events.doc: The game's clock reached a new minute (also when it was set).

events.name: hour
events.doc: The game's clock reached a new hour.

events.name: day
events.doc: The game's date changed.

events.name: tile
events.doc: The player's bus drove onto another tile of the map (numbered as global.cfg's `[map]` list).

events.name: weather
events.doc: The weather changed: another weather file, rain or snow beginning or ending, the snow cover, the clouds.

events.name: light_ahead
events.doc: The traffic light ahead of the bus (within 80 m) changed or a new one came: its aspect (`"red"`, `"red_yellow"`, `"green"`, `"green_yellow"`, `"yellow"`, `"dark"`, `nil` when none is ahead any more) and its distance in metres.

events.name: red_light
events.doc: The bus drove past a traffic light showing red (or red and yellow) at more than 5 km/h.

events.name: speed_limit
events.doc: The speed limit of the lane the bus drives on changed.

events.name: ai_collision
events.doc: The player's bus hit an AI vehicle (its id, as `traffic.list` gives it) with this energy.

events.name: pause
events.doc: The game was paused (the plugins stand still until `resume`; nothing else comes in between).

events.name: resume
events.doc: The game goes on after a pause.

events.name: menu_open
events.doc: The game menu opened.

events.name: menu_close
events.doc: The game menu closed.

events.name: screenshot
events.doc: A screenshot was taken: its file.

events.name: controller_button
events.doc: A button of a steering wheel, joystick or gamepad went down (`true`) or up: the device's name and the button's number.

events.name: lan_join
events.doc: A player joined the LAN session (or came back).

events.name: lan_leave
events.doc: A player left the LAN session.

events.name: lan_message
events.doc: The same plugin on another player's game sent this one a message (`lan.send`): the player's id and the text.

events.name: lan_chat
events.doc: A line was said in the LAN session's chat (by another player or this one).
